Audience: first-time Missouri Class F applicants, from teens on an instruction permit to adult newcomers who will register and maintain a vehicle.
Why it matters to a first-timer: the inspection schedule, fee caps and certificate windows are exact values [A01], the equipment list carries model-year cutoffs and distances [A02], and the plate, projection, towline and slow moving vehicle rules are classic test items [A03].
Level: equipment and threshold recall with many look-alike dates, distances and weights; moderate load.
Prerequisites: the titling and registration chapter for the renewal process, and the rules of the road chapter for the slow moving vehicle sign.
